import json, subprocess, sys

def run(payload):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', 'submission/main.py'], input=payload,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, cwd='/workspace')
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode()

cases = []

cases.append(('bad type', b'{"cases":[{"initial":[],"transactions":[],"bursts":[],"cache_pages":true,"costs":{"hit":1,"miss":1,"decode":[0,0,0]}}]}'))
cases.append(('float hop', b'{"cases":[{"initial":[["::/0",1.5]],"transactions":[],"bursts":[],"cache_pages":1,"costs":{"hit":1,"miss":1,"decode":[0,0,0]}}]}'))

cases.append(('zone id', b'{"cases":[{"initial":[["fe80::1%eth0/64",1]],"transactions":[],"bursts":[],"cache_pages":1,"costs":{"hit":1,"miss":1,"decode":[0,0,0]}}]}'))

cases.append(('whitespace addr', b'{"cases":[{"initial":[[" ::/0",1]],"transactions":[],"bursts":[],"cache_pages":1,"costs":{"hit":1,"miss":1,"decode":[0,0,0]}}]}'))

cases.append(('hop big', b'{"cases":[{"initial":[["::/0",2147483648]],"transactions":[],"bursts":[],"cache_pages":1,"costs":{"hit":1,"miss":1,"decode":[0,0,0]}}]}'))
cases.append(('costs miss<hit', b'{"cases":[{"initial":[],"transactions":[],"bursts":[],"cache_pages":1,"costs":{"hit":5,"miss":4,"decode":[0,0,0]}}]}'))
cases.append(('extra key', b'{"cases":[{"initial":[],"transactions":[],"bursts":[],"cache_pages":1,"costs":{"hit":1,"miss":1,"decode":[0,0,0]},"x":1}]}'))
cases.append(('tx bad op', b'{"cases":[{"initial":[],"transactions":[[["swap","::/0",1]]],"bursts":[],"cache_pages":1,"costs":{"hit":1,"miss":1,"decode":[0,0,0]}}]}'))
cases.append(('empty request', b''))

cases.append(('R=64 valid', json.dumps(big3).encode()))
